businesses.name: DeviceGPT
article_angles: gemini android app functions phone health

features.name: AI Bridge — laptop AI reads live phone data via a local server
features.description: Turn on the Bridge and a laptop AI (via a local MCP wrapper) can query live battery/storage/network/sensor data over your own WiFi — PIN + LAN-only, 10-min auto-timeout, no cloud relay. 29 real endpoints, 3x what the app's own README documents.
features.differentiator: strong — no other phone-health app in this category ships an MCP server

features.name: Consent-gated remote photo capture through the Bridge
features.description: A laptop AI can request a phone photo — but it triggers a native on-screen consent dialog first ('goes only to your laptop, not saved, not uploaded'), and only fires the camera on explicit Allow.
features.differentiator: strong — needs the exact consent-gate wording in any copy to stay honest

features.name: Android 16 App Functions — Gemini can call DeviceGPT directly
features.description: On Android 16, the Gemini app/Assistant can call DeviceGPT's battery/device/network/privacy functions directly through the OS — a user can just ask Gemini 'is my phone healthy?'
features.evidence: appfunctions/BatteryAppFunctions.kt:14-117 + 4 sibling classes, real KSP-generated manifest entries confirmed
features.differentiator: strong — bleeding-edge, almost nobody else ships this yet

features.name: On-device AI explainer, zero network call
features.description: Gemini Nano (ML Kit GenAI) explains scan results entirely on-device — appears as its own 'Private AI · Your phone only · offline' option alongside the 9 cloud AI apps.
features.differentiator: genuine on the specific privacy claim

features.name: Best Devices — trust-weighted crowd ranking
features.description: Shows how your phone MODEL compares to others (not just your personal leaderboard rank), with a trust multiplier that discounts rankings built on thin sample data.
features.differentiator: strong — distinct from the already-marketed personal leaderboard

features.name: Cross-device restore via Android Credential Manager
features.description: Reinstall or switch phones and your language/theme/leaderboard identity restore automatically via Google Sign-In + Android's Restore Credentials API — encrypted, bound to the app's signing certificate.
features.differentiator: novel mechanism, modest scope — do NOT call this 'passkey', it's Google Sign-In via Credential Manager, not FIDO2

features.name: Guest-mode child tracker, no account needed
features.description: A standalone kid-tracker (attendance, homework, Quran, Salah, mood/sleep, BD govt EPI vaccine reminders) reachable from the very first screen, before login. Data adopts into the account if the parent later signs in.

features.name: On-device AI helper (Gemini Nano), free, offline
features.description: Ask AI from the drawer menu — answers fully offline on-device on newer phones, or builds a smart context-aware prompt (screen name + tutorial link) and hands it to ChatGPT/Gemini, with Bangla voice input.
features.evidence: ai/OnDeviceAi.kt:1-61, assist/AiPromptBuilder.kt:54-101, assist/AiAssistSheet.kt:107-109. NOTE: only the drawer entry is guaranteed live — the floating bubble + per-screen contextual button are remote-config gated, default OFF.

features.name: Teacher self check-in, honest about its own limits
features.description: Biometric or QR-poster clock-in that never locks a teacher out (works with no fingerprint sensor), and tells the head master in plain Bangla that a QR scan alone doesn't prove physical presence.

features.name: Automatic parent notification the instant attendance is saved
features.description: No manual step — the moment a teacher saves attendance (single or bulk), every connected parent gets present/absent automatically. Default ON.

features.name: Missed reminders auto-recover instead of vanishing
features.description: If a budget phone's battery-saver kills a class/exam reminder alarm, the app notices next time it opens and still delivers it if the class hasn't started yet.

features.name: Per-student custom fees in one batch screen
features.description: Set a different monthly fee for every student in a class in one screen instead of 200 taps — and explicitly distinguishes ৳0 ('owes nothing') from blank ('use class default').

features.name: Reusable notice templates for real school letterhead
features.description: Save a written notice as a named template; choose whether it prints with the app's digital letterhead or leaves that space blank for a school's own pre-printed paper, with room for a hand signature either way.

features.name: Staff ID cards from incomplete data
features.description: Prints ID cards for staff who never logged in and never filled an HR form — builds a usable card from whatever exists across 3 data sources.
